headline: Milwaukee Museum Returns Pots by Enslaved Artist David Drake to Family
context: The museum restituted two of Drake’s stoneware jars to his heirs, but has found a way to keep both on display. It joins a growing number of institutions that are returning his work to his heirs.

sources.name: The New York Times
